benchmark_isolation.note: The eligible class lexicon was merged before v11 answers existed. v11 answer rows are never read by this activation rule. The activation applies uniformly to the complete pre-v11 reviewed C2A class-only inventory.

evidence.class_authorization: Zorc 2019 Somali-English Dictionary class-only registry, frozen on main before v11; each eligible lemma is explicitly labelled v2a.
evidence.present_person_morphology: Existing reviewed MORPH-CONJ-IIA-MPH-001 present morphology, developed before v11 from independent C2A evidence including Saeed, Green & Morrison, Ahmed Mohamed, Puglielli & Mansuur, and Green & Jones/Green process evidence.
evidence.activation_rationale: v11 was frozen and measured at zero after the class registry existed but before class-level generation. Activating the already-reviewed class morphology uniformly across that preauthorized registry tests cross-lemma generalization rather than target memorization.

notes: Finite class-authorized present generation only. The activation does not change the historical generation_enabled=false flag in the class lexicon, does not create target-specific profiles, does not infer new class membership, does not generate past forms, and grants no correction authority.
